title: How to organise the cleaning supply zone | Hall Closet
description:
Holds the products you clean with, grouped so you carry the right handful to the right room.

This is the Cleaning Supply Zone in the Hall Closet. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Two or three caddies, each labeled on the end with the room it serves, every bottle wearing its original label, bleach products and ammonia products on separate shelves, and the whole zone up out of a small child's reach or behind a latch.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Line every bottle up on the hallway floor.
Straighten: Build a bathroom caddy and a kitchen caddy so you carry the whole job in one hand instead of walking back here
Shine: Wipe the crusted ring off the base of each bottle before it goes back, and lay a wipeable liner on the shelf s
Safety: Chlorine bleach and ammonia products release a choking gas if they leak onto each other, so give them separate
Standardize: Each caddy end reads the room it belongs to.
Sustain: Setting the caddy back on the shelf is when you notice what ran dry, and the empty goes on the shopping list b

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One caddy per room, one open bottle per job, original labels only, and bleach and ammonia kept apart.
